reading: Read all six lemmas and proofs, exact source/premise declarations and L047 interfaces; directly viewed all three frozen proof pages.
mathematical_findings: Disconnected active indices in a primitive orbit force the degree-two exception; commuting normal images, rather than a presumed projected direct product, give the reduction.

End-adjacent case: faithfulness on the other orbit follows from evenness; central pairing and minimal block generation force an independent full block marking. At equality, the invariant binary module and descended sign contradict conjugacy of the extremal block generators.

L047 common extremal recognition applies without projected IP. In an involutory marking the sign-tree alternative would contain a three-cycle on an adjacent tree edge, so is impossible; string commutation then forces the ordinary tree to be a path. The separately accepted degree-five independent-string census covers the endpoint.
For internal indices, odd/even adjacent generator signs exclude transitivity of either commuting factor on the other orbit.

A commuting transitive product transports each factor orbit identically, proving faithful restriction and preserving IP. Oddness forces an odd number of such orbits. The non-symmetric branch uses the complete L047 bound, including small exceptions; the symmetric branch uses its trivial natural centralizer.
For10≤b≤14 the only permissible orbit factorization is12=4·3; the displayed inequalities prove the general rank bound for all b≥15. Thus the exception is excluded in the needed contradiction range.
retained_premises: Entire accepted L047 common/application proof and exact finite premises, Whiston, paired-cut lemma; no circular use of the L044 alternating theorem.
limits: The unrestricted literal degree-two interval assertion of source5.1 remains undecided. This proves the reduction required by the principal high-rank argument, not the full L044 theorem.
